import sympy as sm
print('version:', sm.__version__)
M = sm.eye(6); V = 2*sm.ones(6,2)
print(M.col_insert(3, V))
assert M.col_insert(3, V) == sm.Matrix([

 [0,1,0,2,2,0,1,0],
 [0,0,1,2,2,0,0,1],
 [0,0,0,2,2,0,0,0],

assert sm.eye(3).col_insert(3, 2*sm.ones(3,1)) == sm.Matrix([[1,0,0,2],[0,1,0,2],[0,0,1,2]])

print('all assertions passed')
"
